summary: Event of esv::background::GoalSystem: a character failed a background goal (inspiration). esv::StoryCharacterEventManager::OnBackgroundGoalFailed(EntityRef, GoalFailedOneFrameComponent&) (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xEF3BA0) turns it into Osiris notification 0x72 with the character (from +0) and the goal Guid (+8, as a string). Registered as a normal component (ComponentTypeIdContext) although named OneFrame; storage set up by bg3.exe+0x2707860 (element size 0x18, no destructor = trivially destructible). Saved: model game.background.v1.GoalFailedOneFrameComponent (24 bytes, alignment 8; v0 was 1 byte) written together with core.v0.EntityId - matches an EntityHandle + Guid. Never seen alive. Registry total 24 (server row).
